change_summary: FDA Warning Letter 원문 기준, EzriCare, LLC는 Global Pharma Healthcare를 통한 인공눈물의 비무균·미생물 오염 상태에서 적절한 공급업체 적격성, CMO 품질계약·출하판정, 불만 처리 절차와 조사기록을 갖추지 못했다. 유통 중단 및 회수 상황에서 QA는 공급업체 평가, 불만·CAPA와 재개 전 규제 대응을 관리해야 한다.

impact_summary.value: FDA 검사에서 EzriCare 인공눈물 여러 배치의 비무균 오염이 확인됐고, 제품은 불순·오표시 의약품으로 판단됐습니다. 해당 제품의 수령·유통은 법 위반이며, 미해결 위반은 추가 규제·법적 조치로 이어질 수 있습니다.

evidence.quote: Our analysis of intact (unopened) units found that 14 batches of EzriCare LLC’s Artificial Tears were non-sterile.
Your receipt in interstate commerce of adulterated drugs, and the delivery or proffered delivery thereof, is a violation of section 301(c) of the FD&C Act

affected_work.value: EzriCare 인공눈물의 계약 제조업체·공급업체 적격성 평가, 제품 수령·유통, 불만 처리 및 향후 의약품 유통 재개 여부가 대상입니다.

evidence.quote: Provide a detailed plan to ensure you do not receive or deliver adulterated drugs in interstate commerce, in violation of section 301(c) of the FD&C Act, 21 U.S.C. 331(c). Items in your plan should include a full evaluation of your supplier and contract manufacturer qualification program, including a plan to conduct periodic audits of your suppliers, and a full evaluation of your handling of complaints.

recommendation.value: FDA는 오염 의약품 수령·유통 방지 계획과 공급업체·계약 제조업체 적격성 및 불만 처리 평가를 요구하며, 현재 공급업체·계약 제조업체 평가도 제출하도록 합니다. 유통을 재개할 계획이면 사전에 FDA에 알리고, 시정조치 완료와 CAPA 요약을 제공해야 합니다.

evidence.quote: Items in your plan should include a full evaluation of your supplier and contract manufacturer qualification program, including a plan to conduct periodic audits of your suppliers, and a full evaluation of your handling of complaints. Also provide your evaluation of your current suppliers and contract manufacturers.

If you plan to resume any drug operations regulated under the FD&C Act, notify this office before resumption. You are responsible for resolving all deficiencies and systemic flaws applicable to your drug operations. In your notification to the Agency, provide a summary of your remediations to demonstrate that you have appropriately completed all corrective action and preventive action (CAPA).
After you receive this letter, respond to this office in writing within 15 working days. Specify what you have done to address any violations and to prevent their recurrence.
